## get_force_bonuses

`get_force_bonuses()`

Returns native force modifiers for mining productivity, lab speed/productivity, robot speed/storage/battery, inserter capacity, train braking, manual mining/crafting, character movement/inventory and per-ammo damage/firing speed. Fractional modifiers are additive (0.2 means +20%); capacity bonuses are absolute counts. Entity modules, quality and personal equipment are not included.
